country.evidence_quote: Armstrong International has commenced construction on a new 29,000-square-foot industrial heat pump manufacturing wing at its Three Rivers, Michigan campus. Supported by a grant from the U.S. Department of Energy’s Heat Pump Defense Production Act Program, the facility will enhance Armstrong’s capacity to produce specialized heat pumps for high-demand applications in the United States.
